fishing: WHEN: Tue Nov 24 excellent solunar (91/100), major 11:18a-1:18p; winds N 5-10 mph, air 63-72F, water ~74F, seas light. PASSES-BEACH: whitebait stacked off Stump Pass, Spanish mackerel, jacks, snook, flounder, trout, pompano, sheepshead at Boca Grande / Stump Pass / Englewood Beach / Manasota; live shrimp, gold spoons, whitebait. LEMON BAY: trout, redfish, snook along ICW, bigger redfish. NEARSHORE: mixed on light seas — bonita, cobia, mackerel, tripletail, snappers on structure. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, paddletails. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 20, FL Sportsman Nov 20-22, local reports.
redtide: FWC Nov 24: K. brevis in 40 NWFL samples; bloom concentrations (>100k cells/L) in 14 (Bay and Gulf counties). Prior/very low in one Charlotte SWFL sample; no bloom near Englewood/Manasota. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Dec 4.
bacteria: Sarasota/Charlotte Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key Beach GOOD (10 CFU/100mL Nov 16). Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2 / Sarasota ~148-149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
